connector.name: MCP by speedvault.io
connector.registryDescription: Run web performance audits, get code-level fixes, crawl for SEO, and read real-user Core Web Vitals.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.speedvault, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SPEEDVAULT_API_KEY
env.description: SpeedVault API key used to authenticate audit, crawl, and RUM requests. Create one at https://speedvault.io.

env.name: SPEEDVAULT_API_URL
env.description: Override the SpeedVault API base URL. Optional; defaults to the SpeedVault production API.
